outcome: Poor wound healing (PWH) after cesarean delivery
cohort: The study included 268 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Prolonged operative time, premature rupture of membranes (PROM), emergency cesarean delivery, and uterine scarring were identified as independent risk factors for poor wound healing in GDM patients.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for poor wound healing.
